description:
Thenurtureshop.com is your one-stop online destination for high-quality daily essentials. We aim to make shopping convenient and accessible by offering a wide range of products that cater to various aspects of everyday life. From personal care items like razors, skincare, and essential oils to fashion-forward pieces such as handbags, stylish footwear, we have everything you need to nurture your daily routine. 

At Thenurtureshop.com, we offer an extensive selection of premium daily essentials, including:

  • Personal Care: High-quality razors, haircare, skincare essentials, and cosmetic products designed to elevate your daily grooming routine.
  • Home Comfort: Essential oils, diffusers, bathroom necessities, and daily devotionals to promote relaxation, mindfulness, and wellness in your home.
  • Fashion & Accessories: Stylish handbags, travel bags, fashionable footwear,  for those looking to make a statement.
  • Daily Essentials: Products that make life easier and more comfortable, all curated to fit into your modern lifestyle.

Wide Product Range: From personal care to fashion, we offer a diverse variety of products in one convenient place, making shopping easy and hassle-free.

Convenience: Customers can find everything they need, from self-care items to lifestyle essentials, all in one online store.

Style & Function: Whether it’s skincare, home goods, or fashion, our products not only serve a practical purpose but also reflect a chic and modern aesthetic.

Payment Terms:

  • Affiliate Commission: We offer competitive commission rates for our affiliate partners, based on the number of sales or leads generated through their referral links. Commissions are typically paid weekly after 30 days wait period.
  • Payment Methods: Affiliates will receive payments through PayPal.
  • Cookie Duration: We provide a 180-day cookie window, meaning affiliates will earn commissions for any purchases made within 180 days of a customer clicking their referral link.
  • Minimum Payout: The is no minimum payout threshold. 

Other Information:

  • Affiliate Support: Our dedicated affiliate support team is available to assist with tracking, promotions, and any queries you may have. 
  • Promotional Tools: Affiliates have access to 25% discount on purchased products, and promotions that can be shared with their audience to drive more sales.
  • Performance Tracking: Affiliates can track their sales and commissions in real-time through an intuitive affiliate dashboard.
  • Referral Program: We offer a two-tier referral program, allowing affiliates to earn additional commissions by referring other affiliate partners to our program.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Thenurtureshop.com! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Your affiliate link is generated automatically. Additionally, any coupons will be sent to you through this affiliate link. 

An affiliate may be assigned a specific coupon code, with details and usage instructions provided on the Dashboard. If a customer clicks on the affiliate link and uses the coupon code, a double commission will not be awarded. Affiliates who are not assigned a branded coupon are prohibited from promoting that coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Youtube... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@thenurtureshop.com

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@thenurtureshop.com for support.
